left_items.to_check: P-unknown: HTTP 404 with body code BOOK_NOT_FOUND (body has error and code).; P-soldout: HTTP 400 with body code OUT_OF_STOCK.; Independent read: GET /api/cart in the same cookie jar returns no row for S0 and no row for the nonexistent id (read through the cart list, not the POST response).

P-equal: the second add (to exactly stock) succeeds with a 2xx status.; P-plus-one: the third add answers HTTP 400 with code INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.; GET /api/cart shows exactly one row for B with quantity 5 (not 6).; The row quantity read in Then 3 equals the stock of B (5) after the rejected add, so the rejected request changed nothing.
GET /api/cart contains exactly one row for B (no second row).; That row has quantity 3 (1 + 2: added, not replaced).

P-qty-min and P-qty-max: 2xx; GET /api/cart in that jar shows B with quantity 1 and 999 respectively.; P-qty-over, P-qty-zero, P-qty-fraction, P-qty-string: a 4xx rejection (never 5xx), not a 2xx.; P-id-zero, P-id-negative, P-id-fraction: a 4xx rejection (never 5xx).; Every rejection body contains both `error` and `code` fields, and GET /api/cart in that jar has no row created by the rejected request.

Control: G1's GET /api/cart lists B with quantity 2 (the guest sees its own row).; P-user: JU's GET /api/cart payload (request carrying both U's session and G1's guest cookie) contains no row for B and none of G1's rows (payload inspected directly; a user-owner query that also matches the guest sessionId would return B x2 here).; P-other-guest: G2's GET /api/cart payload contains no row for B and none of G1's rows (payload inspected directly).

P-overlap-higher-guest: B2 in U's cart has quantity 4 (guest 4 over user 1: max, not sum 5).; P-overlap-higher-user: B1 in U's cart has quantity 5 (user 5 over guest 2: max, not sum 7).; P-cap: B3 in U's cart has quantity 3 (guest 6 capped at stock 3).; P-soldout: U's cart has no row for B4.; P-disjoint: B5 is in U's cart with quantity 2; U's cart contains exactly the rows B1 x5, B2 x4, B3 x3, B5 x2 (and no row for B4).; P-unauth: the merge without a session answers 401.

P-set-equal: PUT succeeds (2xx) and the read-back row for B has quantity 5 (set, not added to 1).; P-over: PUT answers 400 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.; After P-over the read-back row for B still has quantity 5.; P-delete: DELETE succeeds and the final GET /api/cart has no row for B.

Foreign PUT answers HTTP 404 with code CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.; Foreign DELETE answers HTTP 404 with code CART_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.; A's after_read rows are identical to the before_read rows (row R_A for K, quantity 2); mutable entity checked: CartItem only.; Positive control: A's own PUT succeeds and the next read shows K with quantity 3, proving R_A is reachable and mutable by its owner (so the 404s and the unchanged state are not an artifact of an unreachable id).; B's own GET /api/cart payload has no row for K.

The add call for B completes successfully (2xx) after the click.; The cart badge text equals the sum of quantities in the cart, 1.; The cart page lists B (by its unique title) with quantity 1; the content, not just the page visibility, is asserted.

P-quote: the quote lists B1 x2 and B2 x1 (items and quantities read from the quote body match the cart read from GET /api/cart). - without this story's change it showed: Then 2 of TC_009 (one Then of five) expects the quote body to list the cart items. The quote of a filled cart answers 200 and prices the cart (subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total), the empty cart is rejected 400, but the body has no items array - the same with no change from this story. R-15 and the documented Quote schema do not ask for items in the quote body, so the assert asks more than the requirement; the person decides.
left_items.how: Decide: remove this check from the test, or refine the requirement it goes beyond (R-15) - the same action without this story's change gives the same result
